say:1:1910436001:1.text: Big guy, why do you look like the sky is about to fall?
say:1:1910436001:1.source_cn: 大个子，你脸色怎么那么难看？
say:1:1910436001:1.male: Big guy, why do you look like the sky is about to fall?
say:1:1910436001:1.female: Lady, why do you look like the sky is about to fall?

say:2:1910436002:1.text: Don't tell me you're actually buying Tentacle Guy's story!
say:2:1910436002:1.source_cn: 喂，你该不会也信那个触手男说的话了吧？！
say:2:1910436002:1.male: Don't tell me you're actually buying Tentacle Guy's story!
say:2:1910436002:1.female: Don't tell me you're actually buying Tentacle Guy's story!

say:3:1910436003:1.text: Elphira can't possibly go crazy! There's nothing wrong with her! You and I both know that, don't we?!
say:3:1910436003:1.source_cn: 艾菲拉不可能发疯，她很正常！咱俩不是最清楚这点的吗？！
say:3:1910436003:1.male: Elphira can't possibly go crazy! There's nothing wrong with her! You and I both know that, don't we?!
say:3:1910436003:1.female: Elphira can't possibly go crazy! There's nothing wrong with her! You and I both know that, don't we?!

say:6:1910436006:1.text: ... The Coralia folks aren't exactly the brightest bunch in the sea. I... I can't even bear to imagine them turning into raving lunatics...
say:6:1910436006:1.source_cn: ……塔拉萨的海裔虽然脑筋有点不灵光，但他们——变成那群...
say:6:1910436006:1.male: ... The Coralia folks aren't exactly the brightest bunch in the sea. I... I can't even bear to imagine them turning into raving lunatics...
say:6:1910436006:1.female: ... The Coralia folks aren't exactly the brightest bunch in the sea. I... I can't even bear to imagine them turning into raving lunatics...

choice_prompt:7:1910436006.source_cn: ……塔拉萨的海裔虽然脑筋有点不灵光，但他们——变成那群深海疯子的样子？咱……咱不敢想……
choice_prompt:7:1910436006.male: ... The Coralia folks aren't exactly the brightest bunch in the sea. I... I can't even bear to imagine them turning into raving lunatics...
choice_prompt:7:1910436006.female: ... The Coralia folks aren't exactly the brightest bunch in the sea. I... I can't even bear to imagine them turning into raving lunatics...

say:8:1910436007:1.text: My Waterstrider's up and running again, so I could leave anytime.
say:8:1910436007:1.source_cn: 水行器已经修好了，咱倒是随时都能走。
say:8:1910436007:1.male: My Waterstrider's up and running again, so I could leave anytime.
say:8:1910436007:1.female: My Waterstrider's up and running again, so I could leave anytime.

say:9:1910436008:1.text: But I can't just walk away and leave the Shallowfolk high and dry... We might not see eye to eye on a lot of things, but they've been good to me.
say:9:1910436008:1.source_cn: 可是，咱不能这样离开。那群浅海裔……咱虽然不理解他们那...
say:9:1910436008:1.male: But I can't just walk away and leave the Shallowfolk high and dry... We might not see eye to eye on a lot of things, but they've been good to me.
say:9:1910436008:1.female: But I can't just walk away and leave the Shallowfolk high and dry... We might not see eye to eye on a lot of things, but they've been good to me.

say:10:1910436009:1.text: There are no cowards in Kaflan, and I, Tolan of Kaflan, sure as heck won't run off on my own!!
say:10:1910436009:1.source_cn: 卡什澜没有胆小鬼，咱——卡什澜的图澜，更不会一个人逃跑！！
say:10:1910436009:1.male: There are no cowards in Kaflan, and I, Tolan of Kaflan, sure as heck won't run off on my own!!
say:10:1910436009:1.female: There are no cowards in Kaflan, and I, Tolan of Kaflan, sure as heck won't run off on my own!!

say:11:1910436010:1.text: I've made up my mind. I'll give you all a ride back to Coralia with my Waterstrider!
say:11:1910436010:1.source_cn: 咱想好了，水行器速度快，能载人，咱先送你们回塔拉萨。
say:11:1910436010:1.male: I've made up my mind. I'll give you all a ride back to Coralia with my Waterstrider!
say:11:1910436010:1.female: I've made up my mind. I'll give you all a ride back to Coralia with my Waterstrider!

say:12:1910436011:1.text: I'll help everyone escape! I'll save as many as I can!
say:12:1910436011:1.source_cn: 真出事了，咱就用水行器带你们逃，能带几个就带几个。
say:12:1910436011:1.male: I'll help everyone escape! I'll save as many as I can!
say:12:1910436011:1.female: I'll help everyone escape! I'll save as many as I can!

say:13:1910436012:1.text: ... Wait, that's only if things go wrong! Ugh, just forget I said that!
say:13:1910436012:1.source_cn: 呸！咱不是说那群海底人一定会出事……唉，你就当咱没说前...
say:13:1910436012:1.male: ... Wait, that's only if things go wrong! Ugh, just forget I said that!
say:13:1910436012:1.female: ... Wait, that's only if things go wrong! Ugh, just forget I said that!

choice_prompt:14:1910436012.text: ... Wait, that's only if things go wrong! Ugh, just forget I said that!

choice_prompt:14:1910436012.male: ... Wait, that's only if things go wrong! Ugh, just forget I said that!
choice_prompt:14:1910436012.female: ... Wait, that's only if things go wrong! Ugh, just forget I said that!

say:15:1910436013:1.text: Ew! Don't give me those heart eyes! You're making me cringe!
say:15:1910436013:1.source_cn: 噫！你……你这什么表情，肉麻！
say:15:1910436013:1.male: Ew! Don't give me those heart eyes! You're making me cringe!
say:15:1910436013:1.female: Ew! Don't give me those heart eyes! You're making me cringe!

say:16:1910436015:1.text: That settles it. I'll go get the Waterstrider and take you up.
say:16:1910436015:1.source_cn: 就这样定了。咱去把水行器推过来，送你们上去。
say:16:1910436015:1.male: That settles it. I'll go get the Waterstrider and take you up.
say:16:1910436015:1.female: That settles it. I'll go get the Waterstrider and take you up.

say:17:1910436016:1.text: I'll figure out my next move once this mess blows over.
say:17:1910436016:1.source_cn: 等眼前这堆麻烦事解决了，咱再考虑回不回岸上。
say:17:1910436016:1.male: I'll figure out my next move once this mess blows over.
say:17:1910436016:1.female: I'll figure out my next move once this mess blows over.

say:19:1910436014:1.text: Ugh, you really need to cut it out, big guy!
say:19:1910436014:1.source_cn: 大个子，你……你再说一句试试看！
say:19:1910436014:1.male: Ugh, you really need to cut it out, big guy!
say:19:1910436014:1.female: Ugh, you really need to cut it out, lady!

choice:14:1:2.text: I'm so proud of you, Tolan!
choice:14:1:2.male: I'm so proud of you, Tolan!
choice:14:1:2.female: I'm so proud of you, Tolan!

choice:7:1:2.text: Are you heading back to shore?
choice:7:1:2.male: Are you heading back to shore?
choice:7:1:2.female: Are you heading back to shore?

choice:5:0:1.text: I'm afraid Calix might be right...
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 卡律的推断很可能是正确的
choice:5:0:1.male: I'm afraid Calix might be right...
choice:5:0:1.female: I'm afraid Calix might be right...

choice:5:1:2.text: There's a good chance the Shallowfolk could go mad, too.
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 浅海裔也可能会染上疯症
choice:5:1:2.male: There's a good chance the Shallowfolk could go mad, too.
choice:5:1:2.female: There's a good chance the Shallowfolk could go mad, too.

say:20:1910436005:1.text: Tch... That look on your face says it all. You can't even convince yourself.
say:20:1910436005:1.source_cn: 啧……瞧你说这话时的表情，难看得要死……装都装得不像。
say:20:1910436005:1.male: Tch... That look on your face says it all. You can't even convince yourself.
say:20:1910436005:1.female: Tch... That look on your face says it all. You can't even convince yourself.
